run_type.dast: Dynamic web app or API testing

code.description: Scans a snapshot of your repository without running its code or installing dependencies.

image.description: Scans an image straight from its registry (Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR…) without running or building it.
image.secrets: Secrets in layers, ENV and history

web.description: Active scanning (DAST) against your running application, on verified domains. Not producing results yet.

source.description: Choose one or more repositories. Each one is scanned from a read-only snapshot.
source.description_with_org: Choose one or more repositories, or a whole organization. Each one is scanned from a read-only snapshot.

mode.label: What to scan
mode.repos_hint: One or more, picked by hand (up to {{limit}})
mode.org_hint: All its repositories except archived ones

source.not_in_app_single: not in the GitHub App: one at a time only
source.empty_text: Pick one or more of your connected repositories from GitHub, GitLab or this workspace.
source.without_app: Scanning several at once only works with GitHub App repositories: their access renews on its own, so it holds up through a batch that runs for hours. Remove {{names}} or scan them one at a time.
source.over_limit: Up to {{limit}} by hand; for more, scan the whole organization.
source.batch_active: A batch is already running ({{label}}): wait for it to finish or cancel it in Scans. Meanwhile you can still scan a single repository.
source.batch_hint: Several at once run as a batch: one at a time and only when nothing else is scanning, so your own scans and PR reviews never wait. Follow its progress in Scans, where you can cancel it.
source.single_hint: Each run scans one repository: the snapshot and its hash identify exactly what was reviewed.
source.dialog_description: Select one or more. Several are scanned as a batch (GitHub App repositories, up to {{limit}}).

org.label: Organization
org.count_error: Couldn't count the repositories in {{name}}. Try again in a moment.
org.estimate_one: {{count}} repository · estimated time {{duration}} (about 1 min per repository; it adjusts to how long they actually take).
org.estimate_other: {{count}} repositories · estimated time {{duration}} (about 1 min per repository; it adjusts to how long they actually take).
org.none: No repositories from that organization are in the GitHub App.
org.dialog_description: All its repositories are scanned (except archived ones), one at a time and only when nothing else is scanning, so your own scans and PR reviews never wait. You can keep using the panel and cancel it whenever you like.

image.title: Images
image.description: One or more references, just as you'd use them with docker pull. They're read from the registry: never pulled into your Docker, run or built.
image.invalid: These don't look like valid references (registry/repository:tag, lowercase): <mono>{{names}}</mono>
image.batch_info: {{total}} images: they run as a batch, one at a time and only when nothing else is scanning. Follow its progress in Scans.
image.batch_active: A batch is already running ({{label}}): wait for it to finish or scan a single image.
image.credentials_saved: The saved credentials for {{registry}} will be used (user {{username}}, token ····{{last4}}).
image.credentials_missing: No credentials for {{registry}}: fine for public images. If it's private, an admin can save a read-only token in Integrations → Container registries.
image.tip: Tip: scan an immutable tag (a version or <mono>@sha256:</mono>) rather than <mono>latest</mono>, so you know exactly what you reviewed.

targets.description: Choose the registered domains and APIs to include in these tests.
targets.empty_text: Pick from your registered domains or register a new one.
targets.limit_hint: Up to {{limit}} targets per run. Adding a domain doesn't send it any test traffic.
targets.dialog_description: Pick from the domains registered in this workspace. Up to {{limit}} per run.

context.description: Whatever you write here is stored with the run and shows up in the report.
context.question: What does this target do?
context.placeholder: Stack and framework, how it authenticates, what sensitive data it handles, which part worries you most…
context.counter: {{length}}/{{max}} · a statement from your team: it doesn't change which rules run and is never sent to an AI model.

review.description: This is exactly what will run, and what won't.
review.batch_code: This creates a batch: each repository is scanned with its own plan, one at a time and only when nothing else is scanning. You can follow it and cancel it in Scans; whatever is already scanned is kept. Batches never send dependencies to api.osv.dev.
review.batch_image: This creates a batch: each image is scanned with its own plan, one at a time and only when nothing else is scanning. You can follow it and cancel it in Scans; whatever is already scanned is kept.
review.plan_loading: Reading the repository to work out what to scan
review.osv_consent: Query OSV for SCA. Turning this on lets Tamandua send this repository's dependency names and versions to api.osv.dev. It's only needed because Trivy isn't available on this server; without it, dependencies go unchecked.

image_runs.packages: System and application packages with Trivy and Grype; advisories both of them report are flagged
image_runs.secrets: Secrets in the layers, the environment variables (ENV) and the build history (ARG, URLs with credentials)
image_runs.config: Configuration: root user, HEALTHCHECK, ADD from a URL, exposed SSH, image age
image_runs.checkov: Checkov on the Dockerfile rebuilt from the history: downloads without TLS verification, unsigned package managers…
image_runs.priority: Priority from CVSS, CISA KEV and EPSS
image_runs.saved_credentials: Access with the saved credentials for {{registry}}

image_skips.run: The image is never run or built
image_skips.source: The source code that produced it isn't scanned (run a code scan on its repository)
image_skips.secrets: No secret value that turns up is stored, only where it was found

review.dast_unavailable: Dynamic tests can't be launched yet: the isolated runner and the rate and scope limits are still missing. This setup is prepared, not run.
review.unverified_targets: Some targets aren't verified. Proving ownership with a DNS TXT record is required before any active test.

launch.dast_unavailable: The isolated DAST runner isn't available yet

batch.confirm_cancel: Cancel the batch? Whatever is already scanned is kept, and the scan in progress finishes.
batch.progress: {{done}} of {{total}} scanned{{failed}} · {{critical}} critical and {{high}} high so far · {{duration}} left. It moves forward whenever nothing else is scanning, so you can keep using the panel.

list.empty_text: Your scans will show up here. Run the first one on a repository or a container image.
list.trigger_advisories: · automatic: published after the last scan
